## Redemption Instructions
To redeem promo codes in Dead by Daylight:
1. Launch Dead by Daylight on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo Switch.
2. Navigate to the in-game 'Store' from the main menu.
3. Click 'Redeem Code' in the top-right corner.
4. Enter your promo code exactly as shown and confirm to claim your reward.
